# Told

> Told records one person's life in their own voice, over as many conversations as it takes, and keeps it for the people who will wish they had asked. Based in Melbourne, Australia. Contact hello@told.media.

Told is a life-story recording and preservation service. Its typical customer is an adult son or daughter who wants to record a parent or grandparent while they still can. It also produces commissioned story collections for retirement living communities, cultural and migrant associations, clubs and societies, and companies.

## What Told does

- Records a person's life across short conversations rather than one long interview.
- Audio by default, video available with a visiting interviewer.
- Offers three ways to record: Told rings the storyteller on their ordinary phone at a scheduled time each week, a family member records with Told's guidance, or a trained interviewer visits.
- The storyteller never has to operate technology. In the phone version they answer, talk and hang up.
- Supports first-language recording (for example Vietnamese, Greek, Italian, Mandarin) with a human-checked translation.
- Delivers the original recordings, a human-reviewed transcript, chapters by place and period, photographs placed against stories, and a structured Life Map of people, places, years and unfinished threads.
- Every story is private by default. Sharing is set per story: only me, my family, my community, or public with written consent.
- Residential aged care is treated as a distinct setting with a specific consent process agreed with the provider.
